answer: Each voting seat must quarry a uniquely serialized onyx benchmark and have it surveyed onto one scarce named summit. The operator posts a 2,500-POA timber bond held for 21 days; two independent licensed surveyors must countersign weekly occupancy proofs, or the bond is slashed and that benchmark ID is burned worldwide. Cloning a mark, or stacking two seats on the same summit, voids every reused registration. A farm of 80 names still has to place 80 distinct marks, occupy 80 summits, and immobilize 200,000 POA for the full window.
